inputs.text: Vertical tight side-angle shot of Lin Xiaoyu nearly confirming a large transfer. The phone front faces away from camera and remains invisible; only its side and matte back are shown. Action: the phone, fingers, wrists and arms remain completely still; only her eyes shift toward the left and her eyebrows lift in surprise. End: the same phone remains fully visible in the same position, back still facing camera. No tapping motion. Motion is extremely small. Preserve the exact first-frame composition, character identity, outfit, props, and room. The camera stays locked and stable. Only subtle lip, eye and eyebrow movement. The phone must never drop, rotate, flip, or leave the frame.
